old_description: Locally owned and operated, Pharmco is a full-service feed, seed, animal health, farming and ranching equipment provider serving the Midwest. When you need expert advice, products, and services that’ll make your operation successful, look to Pharmco.
about:
Pharmco Industries Inc operates from its headquarters in Chamberlain, South Dakota, with additional locations in Platte, Winner, and Kimball. The company describes itself as locally owned and operated, though a founding year and founder names are not disclosed in public materials.

The business functions as a full-service agricultural supplier, offering feed, seed, animal health products, and farming and ranching equipment. Its service portfolio includes ration formulation, nutrition advice, management recommendations, alternative feed sourcing, byproduct comparison and supplement guidance, feedlot profitability analysis, cattle record-keeping with monthly tracking and closeout billing, regular visual cattle inspections, and brokered connections for feedstuffs and livestock. The company does not manufacture these products but sources them from established brands.

Pharmco serves crop and livestock producers across the Midwest, including custom feed yards, feedlot operators, and row-crop farmers. Its customer base spans the livestock, seed, and broader agricultural sectors, with the team drawing on experience in livestock and seed industries to provide tailored recommendations.

The company emphasizes its local ownership and territory-specific services as differentiators, positioning its knowledgeable team and relationships with product suppliers as the foundation for helping customers grow their operations.

name: Phoenix Cable Inc
old_description: Phoenix Cable, Inc (PCI) is a privately owned manufacturer of cable and harness assemblies. We have been in business for over 28 years. We can take your supplied assembly and reverse engineer at no cost or build from a drawing to a workable first article.
about:
Phoenix Cable, Incorporated (PCI) is a family-owned manufacturer of cable and harness assemblies based in Phoenix, Arizona. Founded in 1994, the company has operated for over 28 years as a privately held business.

PCI produces custom cable and wire harness assemblies for a range of applications, with a specialization in semiconductor assemblies developed over the past 20 years. The shop runs automated tooling for wire preparation, crimping, and cable processing, and stocks common UL-style hook-up wire, jacketed cable from 1 to 60 pair, and a variety of connectors and contacts. Every assembly undergoes 100% inspection and testing to IPC/WHMA-A-620 standards, and the company offers reverse engineering at no cost to produce a workable first article. Additional services include custom cable labeling with Brady™ labels, serialization, and global drop-shipping.

The company serves industries including semiconductor, telecommunications, electronics, industrial, commercial, medical, and instrumentation. Customers range from OEMs requiring second-source or equivalent cable assemblies to organizations needing custom designs built from drawings or reverse-engineered from existing samples.

PCI emphasizes short lead times, a comprehensive quality program backed by ISO 9001:2015 certification, and membership in the Wiring Harness Manufacturers Association. Its assemblers are certified to IPC/WHMA-A-620, and the firm promotes blind drop-shipping worldwide to simplify logistics for clients.

about:
Phoenix-Lamar Corporation, founded in 1972 by Maitland Huffman in Austin, Texas, operates as a family-owned contract manufacturer of custom cable assemblies and wire harnesses. Huffman, an electronics enthusiast with multiple degrees, established the company as a family enterprise, a culture that persists with long-tenured employees and repeat customers.

The company produces custom molded cable assemblies, electrical cables, and wire harnesses, offering in-house design, engineering, prototyping, injection molding, and turnkey assembly. All assemblies undergo 100% electrical testing. The homepage notes a global reach with over 200 clients and 150 satisfied clients, though facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Phoenix-Lamar serves industries including computer and electronics, telecommunications, medical diagnostics, biomedical, instrumentation, traffic control, environmental testing, and contract manufacturing. Its client base includes manufacturers of computers and support systems, telecommunication companies, and applied geographical groups. name: Piedmont Food Processing Center
old_description: FROM FIRST TIME FOOD ENTREPRENEURS TO EXPERIENCED FOOD INDUSTRY PROFESSIONALS
about:
Piedmont Food Processing Center (PFPC) operates a commercial kitchen incubator in Hillsborough, North Carolina. The non‑profit was formed in 2018 to manage shared‑kitchen facilities across the state, building on an Orange County facility that was established in 2011 as a joint project of Alamance, Chatham, Durham, and Orange counties.

PFPC provides four dedicated commercial kitchens that clients reserve for exclusive use, with 24/7 access. The center supplies large‑scale equipment (ovens, kettles, blast chillers) while users bring their own small‑wares. It also offers dry, refrigerated, and frozen storage that meets Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) standards. Since opening, the incubator has served more than 500 food businesses, currently hosts about 75 clients, and reports creating roughly 180 jobs and $3 million in annual retail value.

The facility serves first‑time food entrepreneurs and established professionals producing packaged foods, catering and meal‑prep operations, and food‑truck ventures. Clients include brands such as Carolina Caramel, Seal The Seasons, Nellino’s Sauce, Cilantro Artisan Foods, King’s Pepper, The Debonair Chef, and Starfish Bakery.

PFPC emphasizes a low‑risk entry model: no annual fees, no long‑term contracts, and a community of approachable expertise that includes business coaching and direct liaison with regulatory agencies such as the NCDA, Orange County Health Department, USDA, FDA, and OSHA.

name: Pine Crafter Furniture
old_description: Discover timeless craftsmanship and quality at Pine Crafter Furniture. As a family owned and operated furniture manufacturing company since 1983, we specialize in bunk beds, captain beds, case goods, and more. Explore our exquisite collection today!
about:
Pine Crafter Furniture, based in Haleyville, Alabama, has been a family-owned and operated furniture manufacturer since 1983. The company was founded as a domestic furniture producer specializing in solid pine wood bunk beds, captain beds, and case goods.

The company produces a range of bedroom furniture including xStyle Kids Bunk Beds, Twin-to-Full Conversion Kits, xStyle Underbed Storage Units, Adult Bunk Beds, Staircase Bunk Beds, xStyle Captain Beds, Classic Panel Beds, Slatted Beds, and xStyle Case Goods such as desks and chairs, marketed under the Furniture Dash and xStyle collections. Historically, Pine Crafter manufactured domestic furniture lines and also sourced Brazilian-made bunk beds and case goods. As of 2025, the company announced it would discontinue its domestic production and Brazilian-sourced lines once current inventory is depleted, shifting focus to expanding the Furniture Dash product line with new bunk bed styles and additional collections.

Pine Crafter sells its products through a network of furniture retailers and distributors across the United States. The company exhibits at the Tupelo Furniture Market (Building #5, Space #5228) and invites retailers to carry its line.

The company positions itself as a provider of solid pine wood bunk beds in the U.S., emphasizing quality, affordability, and prompt delivery.
